name: Sweet Oak 627M
description: Our acoustic vinyl floors are designed to soak up sounds and improve the acoustics of your rooms.The backing not only absorbs impact noise in the room, but also prevents sound from transferring to rooms below. Welcome to a peaceful home! Engineered for longevity, the hard-wearing top surface perfectly preserves the color and design of your floor. With a floor that’s resistant to daily wear and tear, you enjoy a beautiful looking floor year after year. With a 100% water-resistant top, protecting the flooring from water and spills, our cushion vinyl floors are the perfect choice for kitchens and bathrooms. Resisting stains and scuffs, our floors are designed to withstand daily wear and tear in your home. Moreover, cleaning our cushion vinyl is a piece of cake. With just a minimal amount of water and mild detergent, your floor stays spotlessly clean. This product features our innovative slip-retardant enhancement — making them the safest choice for kitchens and bathrooms.
